Commentary.Commentary: Pakistan now need to chase down a target of 136 runs. They will fancy themselves to do so, especially on such a wicket where the batsmen can really have a go. The Englishmen will have to come up with something really special if they are to get something out of this game. Join us for the run chase which will start in a short while.

After the fall of the first wicket, England were never in this game. The team really needed somebody to stick in and get things going but nobody was able to do that, and as a result, no partnerships were formed. The hosts will be very disappointed, especially on a track which has a lot of runs in it.

The Pakistan bowlers kept taking wickets at regular intervals from that point on and didn't let any English batsman settle. Imad Wasim started it off with a couple of wickets and put them in the driver's seat. Hasan Ali picked up 2 but a special mention has be given to Wahab Riaz who was phenomenal since he was brought on. He bowled with venom and in the process, took his career-best figures in T20Is. Notably scalped important wickets of Buttler and Morgan at a crucial point.

A serious bowling performance from Pakistan here today. Don't know why this wasn't seen earlier in the ODI series. It's been sensational and they have been on top throughout the game. They didn't get off to the best of starts as Jason Roy and Alex Hales made a brisk 56-run stand, but it was all downhill from there.

Yorker on leg stump, Moeen Ali just about manages to get an inside edge onto his pads as the ball goes behind. A quick run is taken but this has been a terrific over from Wahab Riaz. So much variation in it. ENGLAND FINISH ON 135/7!

What a ball from Wahab Riaz! Fires this in full and outside off, 92 mph, Moeen Ali looks to thump it through the off side but misses. And understandably so, that went past him like a rocket. A differnce of literally 20 mph. Unreal stuff!
Fuller length ball outside off, slower one too, Ali lofts this over the covers. It falls safely as the batsmen take two runs.
Liam Plunkett walks into the middle next.

OUT! 3-FER FOR WAHAB RIAZ! He's been spectacular here today. Fuller ball outside off, Willey gives it the full swing of his bat. Gets a thick top edge as the ball skies towards long off. Shoaib Malik there comes running in and takes a good catch to dismiss the batsman.
Full and fired in on leg, it goes off the inside edge onto the pads and towards backward square leg for a couple of quick runs.
Length delivery well outside off, David Willey makes room but that does him in. Is in no position to make any contact as he tries to put bat on ball.
Back of a length delivery around leg, Willey looks to swing with all his might but inside edges it onto his body. One run to end the over.
Leg bye! Shortens the length a bit Amir, on middle and leg, Ali is hit on the body as he goes for the pull. A leg bye is taken.
Full ball speared in on middle and leg, Willey whips this through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Amir is right on the money here. Arrows in a perfect yorker on middle and leg, David Willey just about manages to dig it out towards the mid-wicket fielder. Top bowling this. Two runs are taken.
Back of a length delivery around off, Moeen gets a top edge on his pull which lobs towards square leg. A single is taken.
Seeing Ali making room, Mohammad Amir follows him with a yorker. The ball just scrapes the back pad as the batsman looks to flick it away.
Length ball outside off, run down to short third man for a quick single.
Excellent change of pace from Tanvir. Completely deceives Moeen Ali as he looks to push the fuller ball to covers.
Leg bye! Length ball angling in and it hits David Willey on the thigh pad, it goes behind on the off side as the batsman take a single.

FOUR! BANG! A much needed boundary. England need more of those. Back of a length delivery outside off, Willey picks up the length early and is on to it in a flash. Rocks back and muscles the pull over the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
A little slower in pace and around off, shorter in length as well, Moeen Ali pulls it towards deep backward square leg for another run.
Shortish delivery angling in on middle and leg, pulled through the square leg region for an easy run.
Sohail Tanvir comes back on.
Willey waits for the ball to come in as it's pitched around off, taps it in front of covers and takes a quick single to end the over.
Short of a length ball on the body, Ali pulls this through square leg but doesn't get enough power on it. Good enough to get him a single, though.
Fuller length ball angling in on middle and leg, Moeen Ali works this through the mid-wicket region for two good runs.

Leg bye! Huge lbw appeal turned down. Amir fires it full and swings it in on leg stump, David Willey looks to flick this away but fails to make any connection on it. Is struck on the pads and a loud appeal for a leg before goes up. The umpire isn't interested though as he thought it was going down leg.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
On a length and outside off, Moeen Ali pushes it in front of covers for no run.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
Outside off, Willey looks to slash it away but misses and that's the end of an excellent over.
David Willey is the next man in to bat.

OUT! WAHAB WITH ANOTHER ONE! Excellent delivery that. Great line and cramped Morgan for room there. Just back of a length and around off, Morgan with no room at all looks to cut this away and ends up getting an edge. It flies behind to Sarfraz Ahmed who pouches it with ease to dismiss his counterpart. Wahab Riaz with two important breakthroughs today.
Wide! Shortish and way outside off, Morgan goes after it but misses as it's too far out. Wide signalled though as the ball went across the wide line.
Keeps it on the shorter side here, just around off, Moeen Ali rises and turns it towards mid-wicket. Has to scurry to the other end as a throw is quickly fired at the bowler's end. One run completed.
Length ball outside off, Moeen Ali off his back foot punches it through extra cover and takes a couple of runs for it.
Leg bye! Excellent delivery! Spears in a yorker and it's swinging in on leg, Eoin Morgan looks to flick this away but is rapped on the pads. A leg bye is taken as the ball rolls to the off side.
Wahab Riaz is looking really lively here. He bowls a venomous length ball, hits the deck hard and pitches it outside off, Morgan looks to slash this away hard but fails to make connection on it.
TOP EDGED! Eoin looks to pull that short delivery but gets a top edge. It flies high to the fielder at mid on but doesn't carry. Lucky save for the skipper.
Moeen Ali comes in next to bat.
England are in some serious trouble here. Another wicket down and half their side are back in the pavilion.

OUT! CAUGHT! A huge wicket for Pakistan. Short on middle and off, Stokes stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket. He gets too much of the bottom hand in that shot and the ball gets a little too much air. Babar Azam in the deep has ample time to get into position and takes an easy two-handed catch. England are not looking too good now.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman for a single.
Slower and short ball outside off, Stokes pulls it through the leg side for a single.
Length ball outside off, Stokes blocks it off the back foot with the full face off the bat.
Fullish ball on middle and off, flicked to mid-wicket for a brace.
Leg bye! Wahab gets some inswing again, fires it full and gets it to come into Stokes' pads, raps him here and another leg bye is taken.
Two Leg Byes! Fired in full and going slightly down leg, it goes off Stokes' pads and past the keeper down the leg side. Two leg byes are taken.
Slower one from Wahab Riaz this time, on the stumps, Eoin Morgan stays deep within his crease and pulls it off the toe end of the bat to deep mid-wicket for one run.
Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Ben Stokes drives it down towards mid on and takes a quick single.
Wide! Fuller and going down leg, wide called by the umpire.
Length delivery outside off, chopped towards backward point for a single.
Ben Stokes is the next man in to bat.

OUT! WAHAB RIAZ GETS THE DANGERMAN! What a big, big wicket that is for Pakistan. And it's the big left-armer who does the trick. He's pumped. Length ball around off, Buttler just lofts this over covers after going deep in his crease. He doesn't get all of it and it's straight down the throat of Amad Butt. England have suffered a big blow with that and now find themselves in some real trouble.
Full delivery around off, driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Banged in short on middle and off, Buttler shuffles way across in an attempt to paddle it over Sarfraz's head. He misses and is frustrated a bit with himself for missing out.
Fuller and faster, angling in to Morgan's pads, it's played out towards covers off the leading edge. One run added to the scoreboard.
On a length and outside off, played to point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Buttler punches this off the back foot. It's in the air and fortunately for him, to the left of the bowler who can't get to it. Goes towards mid off as no run is taken.
Tight line from Hasan Ali, keeps it around off, Morgan just opens the face and taps it gently a little behind on the off side. A quick single is taken.
Hasan Ali will have a change of ends.
Fuller ball around off, driven down towards mid off for a single.
On a good length and pitched outside off, Morgan comes forward and opens the face at the last second. Runs it down to third man for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, Jos stands tall, up on his toes and punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Wahab Riaz bowls this with some venom, bangs another short one around off, Buttler walks across and looks to pull this over short fine leg but the ball just hurries past the outside edge.
Wahab once again bangs it in short and outside off, Buttler walks across to try and scoop it over and towards the fine leg fence but fails to do so.
Wahab starts off with a shortish delivery around off, bangs it in hard as the ball shoots off the deck, Morgan hops and taps it down towards third man for a run.
Wahab Riaz comes into the bowling attack.
Smart work from England to see out Imad Wasim. Buttler just works it towards wide long on for a couple of runs.
Short and flat outside off, Morgan is cramped for room but he does well to make some. Cuts it wide of backward point and gets a single to his name.
Easy runs this. Flatter one on off and Jos just punches it to long off for an easy run.
A rare sight of some flight from Imad Wasim, Morgan lunges forward to this one and drives it down to long off for a single.
Pushed quicker through the air, driven down to long on for one run.
Quicker one pushed through outside off, Eoin Morgan with a slightly opened face taps it towards point and scampers to the other end for a quick run.

FOUR! Seems Buttler is in the mood today. Back of a length delivery outside off, Buttler walks across, and as the ball is coming on his body, pulls it through the mid-wicket region to pick up a boundary. Good way to end the over.
On a length and outside off, Buttler cuts this away towards backward point. A good dive from the fielder there stops a certain boundary. Good effort.
Morgan is off the mark. Length ball angled across, the English skipper opens the face and runs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller length delivery on off stump, Jos pushes it down towards mid off for a single.

FOUR! Finds the gap nicely there. Such a dangerous player, Jos Buttler. Full ball outside off, Buttler leans into the shot and powerfully drives it through the gap in the covers to send it all the way to the boundary line.
Eoin Morgan walks in next to bat.

OUT! ROOT IS GONE! England now find themselves in some trouble here. Wickets have tumbled in quick succession. Hasan Ali bangs in a short one outside off, Root hops and upper cuts this towards third man. He's in no control of this shot though as the ball just lobs up. Shoaib Malik positioned there comes running in and takes a good catch.
Jos Buttler is the next batsman in.

OUT! IMAD WASIM WITH ANOTHER ONE! The lad is doing well here, isn't he? Fires in a full ball right on middle stump, it's flat as well, Hales gets down to sweep this away but misses the ball. The middle stump is rocked and now, both openers are back in the pavilion.
On middle and leg, it's once again worked through mid-wicket for another single.
Hales dances down the wicket to this and whips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full ball on the stumps, driven to the man at long on for an easy single.
Length ball outside off, punched to backward point. No run taken.

THAT WAS REALLY CLOSE! Hasan Ali fires in a full ball around off, Root goes for the reverse sweep but misses the ball completely. The ball just whiskers past the off pole and that was a really close call.
Length ball on the stumps, it's punched down to long on for one run.

Root initially preps himself to scoop it over the keeper's head but then seeing the ball pitched well outside off, quickly changes position and opens the face of the bat to dab it down towards third man for a single. Good presence of mind there from the England No.3 batsman.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Hales steps across and with good use of his wrists, hits it down to fine leg for one.
Leg bye! On a length and angling in, Root is hit on the thigh pad as he tries to play at that. A leg bye is taken.
Fuller length ball angled in on the pads, Joe Root works it through mid-wicket and runs hard. It allows him to come back for the second comfortably.
Hasan Ali is intoduced into the attack.
On the shorter side once more, Root pushes this to the cover region off the back foot for a single.
Outside off, Root plays with the turn and places it towards backward point.
Joe Root is in at No.3.

OUT! IMAD WASIM WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! And a much needed one too, England were really turning it up here. A full ball fired in on middle, Jason Roy gets himself into position early and looks to play the reverse sweep. He misses and is hit on the pads. Immediately loud appeals for a leg before go around and the umpire takes no time to raise his finger. The replays show that the ball would go on to clip leg and that's an important wicket for Pakistan.
Flatter and quicker on the middle stump, Jason Roy sweeps it through the mid-wicket region and gets a brace for it.
Slightly shorter in length and pitched outside off, Hales off his back foot dabs it to cover-point and takes a single.
Pushed quicker through the air and outside off, driven to the cover region for nothing.
Imad Wasim is back on the field and ready to bowl again.
Length ball angled across, Roy premeditates and goes for the reverse paddle but misses the ball horribly. Dot ball to end the over.

FOUR! EDGED AND DROPPED! Although admittedly that was a really difficult chance. Fractionally back of a length and outside off, Roy gives it the full swing of his bat. Looks to pull it over mid-wicket but gets a healthy edge behind. Sarfraz dives full stretch to his right and gets his right hand to it, but fails to keep a hold of it. Understandably so, that really just flew away.
Hales pushes this one down towards mid off for a quick single. Good running between the wickets.
Slightly fuller in length, outside off, it's driven to the man at covers. Not the line Sohail Tanvir should be bowling. With the field set, he should be attacking the stumps more.
FOUR! TWO IN TWO FOR HALES! Back of a length delivery outside off, room there for Alex to swing his arms. He camps back and cuts it ever so well past backward point for consecutive boundaries.
A fielding change here. Third man comes in and mid-wicket goes out in the deep.
FOUR! SHOT! Short of a length ball angled across, Alex Hales rocks back in a jiffy and pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Wide! Length ball going down leg, wide signalled by the umpire.
Amir aims it on the pads this time, not the line he wants to be bowling, it's easily turned to the leg side for a single. That's the end of the over.
FOUR! Shot. Sent it all the way. Back of a length delivery on the body, Alex Hales stays back to this one and pulls it fine down the leg side. Sends it all the way to the boundary line with ease.
Length ball on middle and leg, it goes off the inside edge as Hales pulls this away. Goes past short fine leg this time as a couple of runs are taken.

Angling in to Jason Roy that, it goes off the inside half as he tries to pull. Goes to Sohail Tanvir as short fine leg who gets direct hit at the striker's end, but Hales is well in by that time. One run taken.

FOUR! On a length and around off, Jason Roy plants his front foot forward, stands his ground and with a flat bat, hammers it back down the ground to send it all the way. Beats the man at mid off who has no chance of stopping that.

Amir with a cutter to start off with, just takes the pace off the ball a bit and pitches it around off, on the shorter side, Hales stays back and cuts it towards backward point. Runs to the other end for a single as the fielder has a shy at the striker's end. Had he hit, Jason Roy would have been gone. Single is completed.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
Outside off, Hales rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball through the off side for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on for a single.
Shorter ball on middle, Roy looks to scoop it but misses and the ball goes over the stumps to the keeper.
SIX! SLOGGED! Roy lets loose with that one! Length ball on middle, Roy dances down the track and lofts it on the up over mid-wicket. The ball soars over the ground and into the stands.
Shortish ball on the stumps, driven straight back.
FOUR! CLOBBERED! Hales is getting comfortable. Short outside off, Hales punches itt off the back foot and the ball races through the covers.
Length ball on middle and leg, 82 mph, played to mid-wicket.
Full outside off, driven through the covers.
Imad Wasim walks off the ground.
Back of a length ball on the stumps, Roy, pulls it through the leg side for a single.
Slower offcutter around off, 74.6 mph, defended off the back foot for a single.
FOUR! HOOKED! Shortish ball outside off, 80 mph, Hales leans back, pulling it late through mid-wicket. He finds the gap and the ball goes to the boundary.
Mohammad Amir blazes into the attack! One slip in place.

Imad Wasim seems hurt there. He got hit on the head trying to save the ball there and is lying down on the ground. The physio is out to have a close look at it. He seems okay to continue, good to see. An injury is never nice for any player. He's a brave lad.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Hales rocks back and cuts this towards cover-point. Imad Wasim runs to his left and tries to stop it by putting in a dive but there's some bad bounce and the ball hits him on the head. A single is taken by the batsmen but Imad is down on the ground.
On leg stump, it's flicked through square leg for one run.
Another one that's shot up! Just back of a length and outside off, Jason Roy looks to push it to the off side with an angled bat but fails to make any kind of connection.

That's just shot off the surface there. We have a really hard track here, ladies and gents. Tanvir with a back of a length delivery around off, it's a tight line as Roy is cramped for room. He looks to cut it away but the ball just zips off the surface and goes past the outside edge.
Very straight on middle and leg, Alex Hales works it through the square leg region and runs to the other end to complete an easy single.
Wide! Quite poor from Tanvir there. He fires it full and really wide outside off, Hales goes after it in an attempt to put some bat on it but fails to do so.
Sohail Tanvir comes steaming in, bowls a length ball on middle and leg, Hales wrists it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a couple of runs for it.
Sohail Tanvir will bowl from the other end.
Drifting in on leg, it's turned to the leg side for no run to end the over. Decent start from Imad Wasim.
Imad Wasim keeps it on the shorter side once more, it's outside off, Hales punches it down to long off for a single and he's off the mark.
Full on the stumps, it's worked through the mid-wicket region for a single. Jason Roy is off the mark.
Half-tracker around off, flatter as well, Jason slaps it towards the man at wide mid off.
Another one floated up but this time on middle and off, Roy slightly closes the face and drives it towards mid on.
Imad Wasim starts off from around the wicket, floats it up on off, Jason Roy with a straight bat pushes it back to the bowler.

We are all set to get underway as the players and the umpires have walked out into the middle. It will be Alex Hales and Jason Roy who will open the innings for the hosts with surprisingly, Imad Wasim taking the ball first up. So some spin to start things off here.
Pakistan (Playing XI)- Khalid Latif, Sharjeel Khan, Babar Azam, Mohammad Rizwan, Shoaib Malik, Sarfraz Ahmed(w/c), Imad Wasim, Wahab Riaz, Sohail Tanvir, Mohammad Amir, Hasan Ali.
England (Playing XI)- Alex Hales, Jason Roy, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Jos Buttler(w), Ben Stokes, Moeen Ali, Liam Plunkett, Chris Jordan, David Willey, Adil Rashid.
TOSS - England wins the toss and choose to bat first.
Both sides have made a few changes, with England going for a well-balanced side and Pakistan bolstering their pace attack and batting line-up. Join us shortly for the toss.

Yesterday, Australia set the bar high with their furious performance but England have been thriving in the limited overs format recently and we could be in for a real treat today. Pakistan  will be eager to arise from their 4-1 defeat in the ODI series and with Sarfraz Ahmed at the helm, they could have the aggressive attitude to do it.

Hello and welcome to the thunderous conclusion to Pakistan's tour of Britain. The two sides are meeting in a one-off T20I at Old Trafford, Manchester. It is a bright and sunny evening so we can expect to see some fast-paced cricketing action.
